name: visto-israel-law
description: Israeli case law and legislation from psika.visto.co.il: court decisions, consolidated laws and regulations, labor extension orders, municipal bylaws and class actions, each result with a link to the full text.

interface.longDescription:
Visto (psika.visto.co.il) is a legal database of Israel, in Hebrew. The plugin lets ChatGPT search and read it directly, so answers about Israeli law cite real sources instead of guessing.

It covers more than 8 million decisions and judgments of Israeli courts and tribunals, searchable by words, court, judge, dates, statute and section, case number and party; laws and regulations in their consolidated text, section by section, with schedules and the full history of amendments; labor extension orders, collective agreements, municipal bylaws and class actions.

ChatGPT can find decisions on a legal question and read them paragraph by paragraph, see which later decisions cite a decision and every decision of the same proceeding including appeals, find case law applying a section of a law, format a citation by the Israeli uniform citation rules, and check the citations in a draft against the database. A decision, a search, a law, the labor instruments and the class actions can also open as interactive screens inside the conversation. Every result links to the decision or law on psika.visto.co.il. All tools are read-only. Sign-in with a Visto account is required.
capabilities: Read a section of a law and its amendments
Find case law by section or judge

הבא את נוסח סעיף 17 לחוק הגנת השכר
בדוק את האזכורים בטיוטה הזו מול המאגר

positive.description: Case law research on a legal question
positive.prompt: What have Israeli labor courts ruled on dismissal without a hearing? Give two decisions with links.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Israeli labor court decisions on dismissal without a hearing, each with its citation, a short summary and a link to psika.visto.co.il.

positive.description: Text of a section of a law and its amendments
positive.prompt: Show section 17 of the Israeli Wage Protection Law and how it was amended.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Wage Protection Law, 1958, quotes section 17 in its consolidated Hebrew text with a link, and lists its amendments.

positive.description: Who cites a decision and its proceeding
positive.prompt: Search for רע"א 3627/12, then show which later decisions cite it and all decisions in the same proceeding.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the decision, lists the later decisions that cite it and the other decisions of the proceeding, each with a link.

positive.description: Decisions by judge and by section
positive.prompt: Find decisions by judge Dalit Gila, and case law applying section 17 of the Wage Protection Law.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns decisions of that judge and decisions applying the section, each with citation, date and link.

positive.prompt: Check the citations in this draft against the database: רע"א 3627/12 and ע"א 99999/99.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the first citation with its exact title and link, reports that the second was not found, and gives the formatted citation of the first.

negative.description: Request for a court filing action the plugin cannot do
negative.prompt: File a statement of claim for me in the Israeli courts system.
What is the statute of limitations for contract claims in California?

negative.description: Personal legal advice instead of sources
negative.prompt: Tell me whether I will win my case against my employer.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
